fact: On 3 October 2026 the NTRA chief executive said the biometric digital identity verification system, built with the Interior Ministry and ITIDA, had entered a pilot with the four mobile operators for buying lines, opening e-wallets and verifying users, and was also used in Digital Egypt services.
title: «تنظيم الاتصالات» المصري: بدء التطبيق التجريبي للهوية الرقمية مع شركات المحمول الأربع
